119.alt: NORI A3 by Nori Robotics, full body, on its column and caster base
119.identity: Nori Robotics' official homepage hero still: the whole wheeled NORI robot with both manipulators, head, column and caster base, not the torso-only preview. The record is NORI A3 (website announcement and sales offer); no production maturity is implied.

46.alt: K-Bot by K-Scale Labs, full body, front three-quarter view, technical render
46.credit: Image: K-Scale Labs, K-Bot technical render
46.identity: Existing official technical render (assets/pics/f.webp in K-Scale Labs' kbot repository on GitHub): only the complete robot in the top-left panel is kept, with hands and feet. It is a render, not a hardware photograph. The record is K-Bot.

210.alt: NAVIAI WA2 by ZJ Humanoid, full body, on its wheeled base, manufacturer diagram
210.identity: The complete WA2 drawing from ZJ Humanoid's official WA2 product page specification image: the whole wheeled platform; the other views, labels and callout lines are excluded by the alpha mask. A manufacturer diagram, not a hardware photograph; not the i3. The record is NAVIAI WA2.

3.alt: aeo by Aeolus Robotics, full body, two arms on its wheeled chassis
3.identity: Aeolus Robotics' official meet-aeo page, native transparent PNG (2000 × 2427): the whole wheeled robot with both grippers and the full chassis; faint alpha traces at the border removed by levelling the original alpha. Replaces the earlier flyer candidate whose white mast could not be separated from the white wall. The record is aeo.

78.alt: AI Sapiens K0 by ROBOTIS, full body, front view, wearing a cowboy hat
78.credit: Image: ROBOTIS, AI Sapiens K0, cowboy-hat configuration
78.identity: ROBOTIS' official AI Sapiens introduction identifies this file (k0_no_background.png) as K0: the whole biped in its display configuration with a cowboy hat, neck support and hands; nothing added. Not the wheeled AI Worker (FFW). The record is K0.

53.alt: QTrobot by LuxAI, full body, product render
53.identity: The catalogue record is Lux with the model not disclosed; LuxAI's current product page for research and teaching presents QTrobot with this native render (QT_big_hero.png), and photographs on the same page match its geometry. The picture is named QTrobot in the caption and alt text; the record's name and specifications are not changed.

68.alt: PUDU D7 by Pudu Robotics, full body, on its wheeled base, still from the official launch video
68.credit: Image: Pudu Robotics, D7 video still
68.identity: Title frame of Pudu Robotics' official D7 launch video, which names PUDU D7: the whole wheeled humanoid with both hands and the complete base and wheels. The title, logo, stage, light ring and shadow are excluded by the alpha mask. A video still, not proof of autonomy. The record is D7.

190.alt: MATRIX-3 by Matrix Robotics, full body, front view, standing, still from the official introduction video
190.credit: Image: Matrix Robotics, MATRIX-3 video poster
190.identity: Poster of the official MATRIX-3 introduction video on the MATRIX-3 page, beside the MATRIX-3 title: the whole robot with head, hands and both feet; the title is excluded. A manufacturer render or video poster. Never used for the MATRIX-1 record (191). The record is MATRIX-3.

131.alt: Voxel Series-1 by Tuesday Labs, full body, crouching, orange
131.identity: hero-kitchen.jpg, the product image that the JSON-LD Product named Voxel Series-1 on Tuesday Labs' /robot page links to: the whole orange robot crouching, with both hands and feet; the kitchen is excluded. Replaces the earlier white portrait that ended at the shins. The record is Voxel Series-1.

10.alt: Astribot S1, full body, on its wheeled base, still from the official home-page video
10.identity: Poster frame of the official home-page video, whose burnt-in caption reads Astribot S1: the whole robot down to its wheeled base, both arms and grippers; the room and the subtitles are excluded. The s2test directory in the file path is not evidence of another model. A video still, not a capability claim. The record is S1.
